title: Solicit for charity only as authorised
what: Solicit for a charitable purpose only on behalf of an eligible organisation or under the Commissioner's written authority.

sources.title: Collections for Charities Act 2001 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not solicit for a charitable purpose unless – (a) [Section 5 Subsection (1) amended by No. 16 of 2006, s. 7, Applied:01 Nov 2006] that soliciting is on behalf of an organisation which complies with subsection (2) or holds an authority in writing granted by the Commissioner for a specified period;

reach.condition: if it conducts a fundraising appeal for a charitable purpose (including as a commercial fundraiser)
